test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only. (NOTE: All numbers are single digit numbers only.)

(Left) 1 $ 2 6 7 3 * & 4 β μ 2 5 % 9 0 2 3 6 # @ 8 (Right)

If all the symbols are dropped from the series, which of the following numbers will be the fifth from the left?
solution:
Given : Left 1 $ 2 6 7 3 * & 4 β μ 2 5 % 9 0 2 3 6 # @ 8 (Right)

If all the symbols are dropped from the series

**Left 1 2 6 7 3 4 2 5 9 0 2 3 6 8 (Right)**

The number that will be the fifth from the left is 3.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
